# Unique entities per repository and slug

Each entity in a repository must have a unique slug; enforced by a unique constraint on (repo_id, slug).

To avoid duplicate entity records with the same identifying slug within a single repository.

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.EntityRow`
